i.norm: Two tags are unequal when their normalized names differ, even if their (case-sensitive) tag names match. The original tag is built with one literal value used for tag name, normal name, and namespace, then its tagName field is overwritten directly (leaving normalName unchanged). The clone inherits that stale normalName, but calling name(...) recomputes the clone's normalName from the new tag name. So the two tags end up with equal tag names but different normal names, and equals() returns false.
Overwrite only the tag name; normalName stays as the original literal.
Clone copies the stale normalName, then name() recomputes it from the new name.
The clone's normalName was recomputed from the renamed tag name.
Differing normalName values make the two tags unequal.
